title: LocalExtendedCechDescription
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\iota:\mathcal I\to\mathcal O$ be an ideal subsheaf and let $\epsilon:K\to\mathcal O[0]$ be an augmented integer-indexed complex. It has the local extended Cech description if for every $U$, every $r\geq0$, and every slice-generating list $f_1,\ldots,f_r$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generators], there exists an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O_U)$ from the extended localization complex of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-extended-cech] to $K|_U$ commuting with the augmentations. Restriction and the canonical comparison of restricted ring objects are [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction].
